name: Lumi and the Lantern Woods
logline: A tiny teal creature called Lumi and a big, sleepy-eyed lavender owl called Barley have gentle, cozy little adventures in the Lantern Woods.
world: The Lantern Woods: a soft, mossy forest where fireflies glow like tiny lanterns at dusk. Two recurring places: Lumi's Burrow, a round-doored home inside a mossy hill with a warm lamp, an armchair, a patchwork quilt and a round window; and the Clearing, a grassy open space among tall old trees with a mossy path, ferns and a soft stream.
rules: NARRATOR ONLY: one warm storyteller tells every episode; the characters NEVER speak, so no lip sync and no speech bubbles. Nothing scary, nothing fast, no slapstick, no crowds, no on-screen text except the episode title card. Each episode is a complete, self-contained little story with one tiny problem and a warm ending; never mention earlier episodes. Only the named characters appear on screen: Lumi and (when the story needs him) Barley, no other animals or people. Every shot shows ONE simple, clearly visible action with a slow, gentle camera move; characters are seen in medium shots or close-ups, never tiny or far away. Keep hands out of fiddly tasks. Lumi is small and always shorter than Barley; Lumi always wears the yellow bobble hat; Barley always wears his red bow tie.
tone: Warm, cozy, bedtime-friendly, for ages 3 to 7; soft humour from the narration and simple pictures; a one-line moral or a soft smile at the end.
narration_style: Narrated in short, slow, simple sentences. Each episode: set the scene, one tiny problem, a few gentle beats, a warm ending with a soft moral. 9 to 11 calm shots of 7-8 seconds, about 170 words of narration, one narration sentence per shot. Soft ambience under the narration (birds, crickets, rain, a crackling fire), always quieter than the narrator.

places.name: Lumi's Burrow
places.description: A cozy round room inside a mossy hill: warm golden lamp light, a round wooden door, one round window with a view of green leaves, a soft patchwork quilt, a small armchair, a round rug and a little shelf. No people, no text.

places.name: The Clearing
places.description: A grassy clearing in the Lantern Woods: tall old trees all around, a soft mossy path, green ferns, small white flowers, gentle sunbeams through the leaves, a calm little stream. No people, no text.

characters.name: Lumi
characters.description: A small, round, soft teal-blue creature like a plush toy: round body, big cream-colored belly patch, two round ears, big dark friendly eyes, tiny nose, short little arms and legs. Wears a round yellow knitted bobble hat.
characters.personality: Gentle, curious, kind; a little shy and always cheerful.
characters.colors: teal-blue body, cream belly, yellow bobble hat
characters.outfit: yellow knitted bobble hat with a pom-pom

characters.name: Barley
characters.description: A big, round, soft lavender-grey owl like a plush toy: round fluffy body, a cream-colored belly and face disc, huge round yellow eyes, small orange beak, rounded wings. Always wears a small red bow tie.
characters.personality: Wise, sleepy, kind and a little bit silly; moves slowly.
characters.colors: lavender-grey feathers, cream belly and face, red bow tie
characters.silhouette: Big plump round body, much taller than Lumi, with two small ear tufts and rounded wings.
characters.outfit: A small red bow tie under the beak, always worn.
characters.marks: Red bow tie, huge round yellow eyes.
